title: Breadcrumb
description: Shows where the current page sits, such as Home / Jackets / Rain jackets, with links up the trail and an ellipsis for steps it hides.

components.Breadcrumb: Groups all parts of the breadcrumb, which shows where the current page sits.
components.BreadcrumbEllipsis: Stands in for breadcrumb steps that are hidden to save space.
components.BreadcrumbItem: Groups one step of the breadcrumb trail.
components.BreadcrumbLink: Links to a higher level of the breadcrumb trail.
components.BreadcrumbList: Lists the steps of the breadcrumb in order.
components.BreadcrumbPage: Marks the current page as the last step of the breadcrumb.
components.BreadcrumbSeparator: Separates two steps of the breadcrumb.
